entities.name: PMID:25088373
observations: In CFA-treated male Wistar rats, oral and intrathecal BI113823 reduced inflammatory mechanical hyperalgesia; electrophysiology showed reduced mechanosensitivity of peripheral saphenous afferents and spinal nociceptive-specific neurons, but not wide-dynamic-range neurons.
Study supports functional desensitization/modulation at peripheral and spinal levels through B1-receptor antagonism; it did not establish receptor internalization or molecular desensitization.
